description.value: Peaked Pies is a family-run Australian bakery cafe operating in BC since 2013, serving handmade savoury meat pies, sweet pies, breakfast pies, and artisan coffee. The signature 'peaked' pie arrives topped with mushy peas, mashed potatoes, and gravy — a satisfying, portable meal that suits a hungry cyclist well. The West Broadway location is one of four BC outposts and has been voted among the top restaurants in the Whistler chain's home market.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 62m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 79m; stands (2 spaces) at 94m; stands (8 spaces) at 97m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the 732 West Broadway location with matching phone 604-336-0406 and address. The reviews page states 'WE ARE OPEN!' and the site describes an active multi-location family business since 2013. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; vegetarian and vegan options are supported by the blog post titled 'Calling All Vegans...' and the menu page noting 'meat and veggie options available.'
concerns: Blog posts are dated 2019; content may not reflect current menu or offerings, though the business appears actively operating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Australian bakery cafe with a confirmed location at 732 West Broadway; a good stop for cyclists seeking a hearty meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists 'traditional meat and veggie options available'; blog post titled 'Calling All Vegans...' confirms vegan offerings
